bio.text: Caroline Menjivar took the oath of office on December 5, 2022, and represents Burbank and the San Fernando Valley in California's 20th Senate District.

According to her Senate biography, she served in the Marine Corps from 2009 to 2016, last stationed in Miramar as a radio operator and Communications Platoon Sergeant, and later worked as an emergency medical technician and a domestic violence therapist.
She earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Northridge and a Master of Social Welfare from UCLA, and she was born and raised in the communities she represents.
